findings.title: Missing English bundle aborts verification with an unchecked exception
findings.body: verifySafeHtml() derives the English file by rewriting the translated file's path and throws a bare RuntimeException when that file cannot be opened. verify() only declares and handles MojoExecutionException/IOException for reading the target file, so a translation whose English counterpart is absent or named differently (new theme type, renamed bundle, or a standalone properties file) crashes the whole verification run with a stack trace instead of producing a collected verification message, and no other files/keys are reported.

findings.title: Anchor-mismatch message does not identify the key or file
findings.body: When santizeAnchors() rejects an anchor tag it adds only "Didn't find anchor tag ... in original string", without the message key or the properties file. The Illegal HTML branch at line 111 includes both, but this branch runs over hundreds of keys in dozens of locale files, so a build failure from this message gives maintainers/translators no way to locate the offending entry.

findings.title: No test that legitimate HTML passes verification
findings.body:
All new tests assert that a violation is present (illegal tag, HTML where English has none, changed anchor); there is no fixture asserting an empty result for a translation that legitimately reuses the English string's allowed HTML, e.g. matching anchors plus

/
/, numeric placeholder tags, or a MessageFormat choice value. A regression that flags every HTML-bearing translation (for example in santizeAnchors() or the canonical
comparison) would therefore still pass the whole test suite.

findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian account bundle now contains totpStep1="Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian, not Lithuanian. It replaced a Lithuanian sentence when the FreeOTP/Google Authenticator links were removed, so Lithuanian users will see TOTP setup instructions in Italian.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian login bundle now contains loginTotpStep1="Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian, not Lithuanian. It replaced a Lithuanian sentence when the FreeOTP/Google Authenticator links were removed, so Lithuanian users will see TOTP setup instructions in Italian on the login pages.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle now uses Traditional Chinese for totpStep1
findings.body: totpStep1 was changed to "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：", written in Traditional Chinese characters (手機, 應用程式, 之一), while the rest of this messages_zh_CN (Simplified Chinese) bundle uses Simplified characters. Simplified Chinese users will see an inconsistent script for the TOTP setup instruction; the Simplified rendering of the new English sentence should be used instead.
